description.p: Sleepy Launcher is an unofficial launcher for Zenless Zone Zero that handles setting up Wine and installing the game on Linux.
Sleepy Launcher ist ein inoffizieller Launcher für Zenless Zone Zero, der die Einrichtung von Wine und die Installation des Spiels unter Linux übernimmt.
Sleepy Launcher - это неофициальный лаунчер для Zenless Zone Zero, который настраивает Wine и устанавливает игру на Linux.
Sleepy Launcher es un launcher no oficial para Zenless Zone Zero que se encarga de configurar Wine e instalar el juego en Linux.
Sleepy Launcher è un launcher non ufficiale per Zenless Zone Zero che gestisce la configurazione di Wine e l'installazione del gioco su Linux.
A Sleepy Launcher egy nem hivatalos indítóprogram a Zenless Zone Zero játékhoz, amely kezeli a Wine beállítását és a játék telepítését Linuxon.
Fixed %temp% and %game% command keywords being mixed up
Launcher will now only prompt to install DX12 dependencies when DX12 is enabled
Added option to enable DirectX 12 support
Added NTSync as a wine sync method (cosmetic/no-op, NTSync is used automatically on supported wine versions)
Added command-line arguments help text
Improved readability of progress bar text
Fixed "path is not mounted" error in some edge cases related to btrfs subvolumes
Added additional methods of detecting game version
Fixed game version detection on import
Fixed "Path not mounted" error when checking for free space during component download
Added "Remake prefix" button
Added "Import game" button
Added setting to enable Winewayland to make the game use Wayland instead of X11
Added a setting to enable "Timeout fix"
Added automatic detection and suggestion for the "Timeout fix" setting
Fixed a panic when the launcher folder is a broken symlink, the launcher will exit with an error message instead
Fixed search url extractor
Changed .version file format to be a textual file that can be edited in a text editor. Old format files will still work correctly and will be overwritten on game update.
The video background will now pause when the game is launched
The video background is muted (the audio output still exists, file's audio is ignored)
Changed the way the video background is displayed, improving the look when the window is resized
Added support for animated backgrounds (can be turned off in the settings)
Added support for selecting the background via config file if there are multiple
Fixed signal search error message in english
Removed imagemagick dependency
Added support for layered launcher backgrounds (background separate from text)
Fixed size of images in the "Appearance" preferences section (most noticeable on flatpak)
Updated default window size in classic appearance option to match the other launchers
Removed dwebp dependency, replaced by imagemagick
